newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar slips as Cenbank steps aside.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar slips as Cenbank steps aside.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly weaker at 480.75/481.75 per dollar Wednesday compared to 480.00/481.00 per dollar Tuesday, as the Central Bank failed to respond to heavy foreign currency demand from one large bank in the afternoon, traders said.
"In the morning the Central Bank came in and lowered the rate, but in the afternoon a large bank started demanding currency and I did not see the Central Bank anywhere," one said.
Traders said that in general the currency market was calm with little pressure on the bolivar to depreciate.
Currency markets will be closed Thursday for the Labor Day public holiday. They will reopen Friday.
